rows.runtimeOwner: packages/cli/src/review-label-cli.mjs — after session resolution it resolves the model in-process (resolveModel, tier capable default) and writes the stamp into loadSession().dir before printing the label

rows.capability: review-evidence — the recorded grade: stamp decides when the host cannot answer, never below the substance floor
rows.library: packages/cli/src/review-census.mjs (stamp consultation when hostFinalReview is null and the evidence has no well-formed final bucket; CENSUS_RULE 5)
rows.runtimeOwner: packages/cli/src/set-phase.mjs freezeReviewVerdict() on phase finish|done (feeds enforceFinalReviewFloor, the money/auth gate); packages/cli/src/score.mjs and ledger.mjs via the frozen verdict
rows.writes: session.json → reviewVerdict {final, evidence:'recorded', ...} via set-phase's existing freeze; .forge/sessions.jsonl digest line via the existing ledger
rows.reads: <sessionDir>/reviews/dispatches.json (via readStamps), the evidence object from reviewEvidence, <sessionDir>/reviews/final-review*.md presence
rows.uiConsumer: forge phase done gate outcome, forge score scorecard, forge fleet report, session-status
rows.evidence: packages/cli/src/review-census.test.mjs (recorded path pins prose-not-read; host wins over stamp; below-floor bucket routes to prose; sessionId mismatch and malformed file fall through) + set-phase.test.mjs (gate passes on recorded; frozen host verdict not downgraded; recorded refreshes to host self) + e2e step review-stamp-decides

rows.capability: review-evidence — a partial binding's absence-negative does not outrank the stamp (D4)
rows.library: packages/cli/src/metrics/review-evidence.mjs (partial: bound ids vs transcripts found on disk) + packages/cli/src/review-census.mjs (hostFinalReview's fromAbsence marker; the override in reviewCensus's final-review loop)

rows.reads: <sessionDir>/reviews/dispatches.json (stamp), the bound host transcripts still on disk (partial computed from what is missing)
